versions.changelog:
Initial release of merged-social-poster-skill, combining social card and magazine-poster generation features.

- Merges guizang-social-card (28 layouts, 10 themes, Playwright PNG rendering) with magazine-poster templates.
- Supports professional social cards, 小红书图文, 公众号封面, magazine posters, carousels, and more.
- Offers both Editorial and Swiss visual systems for style and theme selection.
- Includes article illustration system, validation via 6-rule QA checklist, and quick-start example prompts.
- Provides Playwright-based rendering to PNG in multiple aspect ratios.
- Organized file structure for templates, layout recipes, renderer, and validation scripts.
